title: Find the bug in a title_case function
prompt:
This function is supposed to capitalize the first letter of every word in a sentence but only capitalizes the very first word.

def title_case(s):
    return s[0].upper() + s[1:]

Identify the bug and explain the fix.

metadata.notes: Bug: only touches the first character of the whole string, not each word. Fix should split on spaces, capitalize each word, and rejoin (or use str.title(), with a note on its own apostrophe edge cases). Graded manually.
